canonical_entity.generation: valid UUID keeps bits; non-UUID uses frozen typed deterministic mapping; new entity receives UUID once before retry
canonical_entity.compatibility: legacy_id has no blanket expiry; existing wire identity remains legacy_id
canonical_entity.comparison: one-to-one entity mapping; exact non-ID fields; old URL and next mutation
canonical_entity.recovery: restore pre-migration baseline; do not reverse hash

canonical_reference.generation: resolve through target entity mapping, never independent random assignment
canonical_reference.compatibility: resolve legacy/canonical inputs; preserve old wire identity
canonical_reference.comparison: parent-child correspondence; nullable/composite uniqueness and delete/update actions
canonical_reference.recovery: restore pre-migration baseline plus frozen mapping

canonical_retained_reference.generation: same target entity mapping including preallocated/deleted identities
canonical_retained_reference.compatibility: retained reference survives target cleanup; no blanket alias expiry
canonical_retained_reference.comparison: exact reference meaning, old replay fencing, target presence classification
canonical_retained_reference.recovery: restore pre-migration baseline plus retained alias mapping

polymorphic_reference.generation: OCR or analysis namespace selected by task_kind; no generic hash over text alone
polymorphic_reference.compatibility: owner/lease tokens and task identity stay stable
polymorphic_reference.recovery: restore source baseline; workers remain stopped

frozen_storage.generation: existing storage/checksum identity; no UPDATE/backfill/type rewrite of stored identity
frozen_storage.comparison: exact header fields and bytea bytes; JSONB value plus original decode/canonical checksum
frozen_storage.recovery: restore original rows; never rehash rewritten payload

encoded_reference.compatibility: validate original bytes/value/checksum before temporary identity projection
encoded_reference.comparison: original serialization/checksum plus reference semantics and next operation

notification.compatibility: stored envelopes, parts, targets and context remain exact
notification.recovery: restore source baseline; outbound delivery disabled in rehearsal

opaque_image.generation: existing image-store identity; new source-image canonical id can serialize as text
opaque_image.compatibility: historical local image identity/path and new source-image identity coexist
opaque_image.comparison: same object identity and old payload lookup; never rewrite object key/path
opaque_image.recovery: restore metadata; object mirror independently verified

operational.compatibility: do not reinterpret UUID-looking operational names
operational.comparison: exact worker/reader identity, version capability and lease ownership
operational.recovery: restore source baseline; restart fixed consumers only

replay_legacy.compatibility: legacy exact-key lookup and hash comparison precede new UUID validation; expiry unchanged
replay_legacy.comparison: replay/pending/conflict/expiry/account isolation and saved response bytes
replay_legacy.recovery: restore original replay table; do not copy new writes backward

semantic.compatibility: unchanged and not derived from canonical UUID
semantic.comparison: exact value; fixed roster/incident key/Discord and checksum contracts
